summary: Iteration 13 verified all 5 new deliverables + regressions. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass in test_iteration_13.py — JB /auth/me returns non-empty bio ('Founder. 4th best cyclist in Grey Lynn.') and ISO member_since; PATCH /riders/me with '2018-03-15' persists correctly; invalid date → 400 with 'Invalid member_since date'; POST /chat/mechanical returns top-level id + mechanical.maps_link (https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=...) and message appears in GET /chat/messages by id; webpush vapid-key/subscribe/unsubscribe healthy; announcement gating enforced (JB=true, Leo forced false); /rides/cafe-suggest?q=Airport loop → Daily Bread · Britomart; ?q=Jailbreak → Little Sister · Henderson. Frontend: JB login → Riders tab → profile modal shows profile-since-input pre-populated with prior value (2018-03-15), editing to 2019-07-04 fires PATCH /api/riders/me (200) with member_since=2019-07-04T00:00:00, re-open shows persisted value. Code-check verified onTouchStart+onTouchEnd handlers are attached to data-testid=tab-content React fiber. Code-check verified usePullToDismiss exposes dx, MemberCard outer div uses translate(dx,dy), RidersTab ProfileModal outer wrapper uses translate(dx,dy) (line 285). ChatTab optimistically appends mechanical message on POST return with id-dedup vs WS chat.message. No regressions found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2659 lines — still recommend splitting into routers (chat, webpush, admin, rides). Non-blocking.
RidersTab.jsx is 1055 lines and contains both RiderList + ProfileModal + delete dialog + card modal. Consider splitting ProfileModal into its own file.
The 'other' modal in RidersTab.jsx (line 689) only uses translateY(dy) — if it should also support swipe-right dismissal, extend it. Not in scope of this iteration but worth flagging.
usePullToDismiss.js: axis lock threshold is 10px which is tight; on trackpads it may false-trigger horizontal lock while user intends vertical. Consider raising to 12–15px or requiring a small ratio.
